title: openAPPindex: open dataset and code on discovery and price disclosure in the German iOS App Store
description:
Snapshot of the openAPPindex repository (github.com/tim-muky/openappindex): the scripts and the published dataset behind the working paper Search Without Recall: Preliminary Evidence on Discovery Failure and Price Opacity in a Mobile Application Market.

The dataset records, for two categories of the German iOS App Store, which apps the store's own search returns and what Apple publishes about their prices and in-app purchases. Cooking apps were measured 19 August to 1 September 2026; sleep and meditation apps 1–2 September 2026. Every record carries the date it was read from public Apple endpoints.

What is in it. Facts only: names, developers, categories, versions, dates, listed prices, rating counts, and Apple's published in-app purchase lists. App descriptions and release-note text are deliberately excluded (they are the copyright of their developers); only their length and presence are kept. A value that was not collected is published as missing, never as zero. Prices are never annualised: an in-app purchase is reported as Apple lists it, with the developer's own label, and is never converted to a per-year figure.

Known limitations. Two categories, one storefront, one platform, a short window. Category membership comes from a keyword classifier (sample/classify.py), which has needed four documented correction passes; the corrections are in sample/data/public/corrections.json and on openappindex.org/methode.html. Apple's product pages list at most ten in-app purchases, so for an app whose list sits at ten, the highest in-app purchase recorded here is a lower bound.

Licences. This record is the software archive and carries the code licence, AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE). The datasets inside it, sample/data/public/ (cooking) and sleep/data/public/ (sleep and meditation), are licensed separately under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA); the licence recorded on this page does not change that.

Corrections. If something here is wrong, write to korrektur@openappindex.org. Every notice is checked and corrections are published with a date.
